sents.zh: 一千三百多年以前，中国有一个很大的朝代，叫唐朝。
sents.en: More than thirteen hundred years ago China had a great dynasty called the Tang.
The Tang’s greatest city was Chang’an.

sents.zh: 那时候，它是世界上最大的城。
sents.en: At that time it was the largest city in the world.
More than a million people lived in it.

sents.zh: 城里的路又直又长，走一次要很久。
sents.en: Its streets were straight and long, and took a long time to walk.

sents.zh: 因为唐朝很有名，所以很多国家的人都来了。
sents.en: Because the Tang was so renowned, people came from many countries.

sents.zh: 他们有的来做买卖，有的来读书。
sents.en: Some came to trade, some came to study.

sents.zh: 他们带来了马、水果，还有新的音乐。
sents.en: They brought horses, fruit, and new music.

sents.zh: 城里的人可以吃到很远地方来的东西。
sents.en: People in the city could eat food from very far away.

sents.zh: 唐朝也有很多有名的诗人。
sents.en: The Tang had many famous poets too.

sents.zh: 其中最有名的一个叫李白。
sents.en: The most famous of them was called Li Bai.

sents.zh: 他写了很多美的诗，到今天大家还在读。
sents.en: He wrote many beautiful poems, still read today.

sents.zh: 那时候，女人也可以读书，也可以骑马。
sents.en: In those days women could study, and could ride horses.

sents.zh: 虽然后来长安没有以前那么大了，但是它的故事留了下来。
sents.en: Although Chang’an later grew smaller, its story remained.

sents.zh: 很多人说，唐朝是中国最好的时候之一。
sents.en: Many say the Tang was one of the finest times in China.
